effect_if_accepted: P2-1 reusable exact-Wilson workflow integration is accepted and P2-2 bounded CO/PBE transfer followed by the fixed-geometry NH3 bridge is authorized. Acceptance does not qualify reduced-action dynamics, a general magnetic envelope, spatially nonuniform sources, or later production applications.
limitations: The reusable numerical anchor is exact Kohn-Sham LDA H3+/cc-pVDZ on the unpruned level-4 grid with weigend auxiliary basis; exact GGA molecular transfer remains P2-2 work.

The first reusable affine schema supports zero or compact potential-first electric pulses and a magnetic field linear in time. It does not encode the accepted NQ6 direct-electric envelope or a general time-dependent magnetic envelope.
Reduced P0, strict-C1, and density-resummed-C1 configuration/state preparation exists, but reusable reduced dynamics is rejected until P2-6.

Pseudopotentials, nonlocal ionic operators, hybrids, moving nuclei, periodic boundaries, adaptive stepping, Maxwell backreaction, spatially nonuniform/EELS potentials, and magnetic-field Casida response remain out of scope.

The first qualification attempt is retained as failed-visible evidence after completing all static and restart work; the failure was a qualification-driver API-signature error at entry to the separate driven oracle. The successful continuation authenticates every reused artifact by SHA-256.
Qualification timings are machine-specific and are not production performance guarantees.
